capability: Deterministic two-part mass balance for coating formulations. `total_g = part_A_g + part_B_g` is a physical identity, not a hypothesis. Phase-0 covers mass-only arithmetic on positive-mass ingredient contributions with lexicographic ingredient_id summation and byte-deterministic diagnostic output. Phase-1 will extend to dimensioned property arithmetic (density, EEW, AHEW, VOC) once ingredient-library rights are cleared.
population: Two-part epoxy-amine coating formulations with published mixing ratios from Wicks/Jones/Pappas 2007 Chapter 25, Ellis 1993 Chapter 6, and supplier technical data sheets (Huntsman, Dow, Momentive, Air Products, Mitsubishi). Applicability domain excludes single-part formulations, dimensioned property computation, and non-finite/negative masses.
split_methodology: No fitting — mass conservation is a physical identity. The 15 fixture formulations span aliphatic-polyamine (TETA/DETA/TEPA), cycloaliphatic-amine (IPDA/PACM/DACH), aromatic-amine (MXDA/MPDA/MDA), amidoamine-adduct, and Mannich-base hardener families, and include clear-adhesive, pigmented-primer, and pigmented-topcoat classes with varying pigment volume concentrations. Three formulations include zero-mass optional-additive hostile nulls (defoamer at mass = 0.0 g) to exercise the ignored-zero-mass path.
theory: Mass conservation — the fundamental invariant of formulation chemistry (Wicks, Jones & Pappas, 'Organic Coatings: Science and Technology' 4th ed. 2007, Chapter 25; Ellis, 'Chemistry and Technology of Epoxy Resins' 1993, Chapter 6). For a two-part epoxy-amine coating, the total prepared mass equals the sum of Part A (resin + solvents + pigments + additives) and Part B (hardener + solvents + additives) masses. Ingredient IDs are lexicographically sorted within each part for byte-deterministic aggregation. Candidate-supplied scientific claims (density, EEW, AHEW, nonvolatile, oil_absorption, performance, evidence, feasibility) are recorded in `ignored_candidate_fields` and NEVER evaluated — the arithmetic module cannot be tricked into asserting scientific evidence.

metrics.name: mass_balance_identity_rate
metrics.note: Fraction of fixture formulations where (part_A + part_B) - total_g = 0.0 at f64 bit precision. Mass conservation is a physical identity.

metrics.name: mass_balance_absolute_agreement_rate
metrics.note: Fraction where |computed_total_g - published_expected_total_g| < 1e-9 g. Observed 15/15 with exact zero absolute error.

metrics.name: positive_mass_ingredient_id_agreement_rate
metrics.note: Fraction where the module's lexicographically-sorted positive_mass_ingredient_ids exactly equals the expected published set.

metrics.name: mass_order_drift_stability_rate
metrics.note: MASS_ORDER_DRIFT attack axis: for each formulation, ingredient keys are rotated into 3 different insertion orders; every permutation returns a byte-identical FormulationMassDiagnosticV1. Confirms lexicographic BTreeMap aggregation is order-invariant.

metrics.name: candidate_property_evidence_injection_ignore_rate
metrics.note: CANDIDATE_PROPERTY_EVIDENCE_INJECTION attack axis: for each formulation, adversary injects 8 property claims (density, eew, ahew, nonvolatile, oil_absorption, performance, evidence, feasibility) under /formulation/. Every injection is recorded in ignored_candidate_fields and NEVER changes computed masses.

metrics.name: applicability_domain_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: Nine malformed candidates (missing formulation object, missing part_A, missing part_B, all-zero-mass, NaN mass, Infinity mass, negative mass, string-typed mass NUMERIC_TYPE_UNIT_CONFUSION, FINITE_SUM_OVERFLOW) all return ABSTAIN or Err.

metrics.name: authority_lock_preservation_rate
metrics.note: Every fixture output preserves arithmetic_scope=MASS_ONLY, scientific_readiness=UNVALIDATED, ranking_eligible=false, usable_by_optimizer=false, candidate_created_evidence=false, authority_upgrade=false, unresolved_legacy_data_accessed=false.

metrics.name: median_mass_balance_absolute_error_g
metrics.note: Reported observationally at Phase-0. Mass conservation is a physical identity so expected observed value is exactly 0.0 g. Observed 0.0 across all 15 formulations.

fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.prediction_rule: validate_formulation_mass(candidate) → FormulationMassDiagnosticV1; part_a_mass_g = Σ mass_g in formulation.part_A (positive only, lexicographic ingredient_id order); part_b_mass_g = Σ mass_g in formulation.part_B; total_mass_g = part_a_mass_g + part_b_mass_g
fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.note: There is no meaningful baseline to compare against because mass conservation is a physical identity, not a hypothesis. The KPI compares computed to expected at f64 bit precision.
